messages:
Rhea Kapoor: kicking off SentinelAI onboarding 1: quick alignment thread for owners, success criteria, and first-30 plan. keep replies short please.

Rhea Kapoor: Suggested success criteria:
- Staging API integrated & smoke tests green
- Demo p95 latency < 200ms for 1k reqs
- Two recorded enablement sessions (dev + ops)
- Security checklist acknowledged by their SOC

Liam O'Brien: Ill own the API integration and provide staging endpoint. Aim to have first endpoint by Day 4.

Zoe Park: CS ops will draft the 30/60 checklist and the onboarding playbook. Will add finance PO check on Day 9.

Carlos Mendes: Security lead here  will send pen-test scope and dataflow. Need their SOC contact and retention requirements.

OnboardBot: Calendar event created: "SentinelAI Onboarding - Weekly" Mon May 11 09:30 PDT. Invitees: Rhea, Liam, Zoe, Carlos.

Liam O'Brien: sample curl for staging (temp token):
```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.internal/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer stg_sntl_77" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-mini","input":"ping"}'
```

Carlos Mendes: Note: responses include latency_ms and request_id. Ill prepare a short doc on how we capture metrics for renewal stories.

Zoe Park: Action items:
- Liam: staging endpoint + curl (Due Day 4)
- Carlos: pen-test scope + dataflow (Due Day 5)
- Rhea: baseline metrics plan + kickoff note (Due Day 2)
- Zoe: playbook + finance checkpoint (Day 9)

Rhea Kapoor: Risk flags: SOC delays could push demo; PO path for spikes unclear. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you confirm your item.

Liam O'Brien: :white_check_mark:
